abstract: Produce quantized LLMs for a target engine and hardware: GGUF (llama.cpp), EXL3 (ExLlamaV3/TabbyAPI), AWQ/GPTQ/FP8/NVFP4 (LLM Compressor, NVIDIA Model Optimizer) for vLLM, SGLang and TensorRT-LLM, and MLX (mlx-lm). Includes calibration, quality checks against the base model (KL divergence, perplexity, smoke prompts), memory-safe execution on unified-memory machines like DGX Spark, and publishing to Hugging Face with base_model metadata and the full recipe.
